resolution.note: successor-launch refuses max; handoff skill launches at medium; settings effortLevel medium, subagents Sonnet at medium

title: Cap KRN session effort at xhigh, default medium, and run subagents on Sonnet
body:
Operator (2026-11-08, verbatim): "najlepiej od razu odpal sesję jak należy i realnie zmniejsz do medium a jesli to nie bedzie wystarczające to potem na high, MAXIMUM TO EXTRA HIGH MASZ TO ZASTOSOWAĆ JAK NAJSZYBCIEJ"; also: give krn-lead subagents a cheaper model.
Evidence: the operator's usage report found 16 lead sessions and 26 general-purpose subagents at max effort in 24 h, all from .agents/skills/krn-handoff/SKILL.md:25 (successor-launch.ts --effort max, 844 calls in transcripts); subagents inherit the session effort unless CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT is set (Claude Code 2.1.316 binary strings: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL, CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT, effortLevel).
Outcome: successor-launch.ts refuses --effort max and accepts low, medium, high and xhigh; the handoff skill launches at medium; .claude/settings.json sets effortLevel medium and runs subagents on claude-sonnet-5-5 at medium unless a call names another model.
